blocks.text: Your God-given gift is what the Greek calls "charisma" - grace, favour, or talent that equips you to do certain things in a special way - {{1co 12:4|1 Corinthians 12:4}}. It's activated at the point of salvation and/or the baptism of the Holy Spirit, and can also be imparted through holy and anointed servants of God - {{rm 1:11|Romans 1:11}}.
Gifts exist for two purposes: to glorify the Father - {{re 4:11|Revelation 4:11}}, and to build up the church - {{eph 4:12,eph 4:13|Ephesians 4:12-13}}.

cards.heading: Three ways a gift can be misused

blocks.text: A spiritual gift can be abused in three ways:

items: By not using the gift you've been given - {{2tm 1:6|2 Timothy 1:6}}; {{1tm 4:14|1 Timothy 4:14}}.
By attempting to operate a gift that hasn't been given to you - {{act 8:9,act 8:13,act 8:18,act 8:19|Acts 8:9, 13, 18-19}}.
By exercising a gift without love - {{1co 13:1|1 Corinthians 13:1}}.
